faq_heading: Homes near Bayridge Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Bayridge Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Bayridge Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Bayridge Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Bayridge Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 70 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,434,000, townhomes $842,000, condos $528,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Bayridge Elementary?
faq.a: For the 70 homes that sold within 1 km of Bayridge Elementary, the median time on the market was 38 days and the median sale was 94.9% of list; 3% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Bayridge Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are H T Thrift Elementary (1.1 km east), Semiahmoo Secondary (1.1 km east) and Ray Shepherd Elementary (1.2 km west).

Bayridge Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 1730 142 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Bayridge Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Bayridge Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Bayridge Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Bayridge Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 70 homes sold within 1 km of Bayridge Elementary: 47 houses, 15 townhomes and 7 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,434,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Bayridge Elementary

13 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Bayridge Elementary in a straight line (8 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is H T Thrift Elementary, 1.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is Semiahmoo Trail Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Semiahmoo Secondary (1.1 km); the nearest independent school is Newbridge Academy (2.0 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Elgin Park Secondary (2.0 km). Other elementary schools close by: H T Thrift Elementary (1.1 km east), Ray Shepherd Elementary (1.2 km west), Chantrell Creek Elementary (2.0 km north-west), Star of the Sea (2.1 km north-east), Laronde Elementary (2.2 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is H T Thrift Elementary, 1.1 km east of Bayridge Elementary.
